function: Perk levels (every level of every IPerkListDefinition perk)
description: The built data of every perk level: SP price, droid AI slots, granted feats, requirements, stat bonuses and a fingerprint of the description.
inputs: 986 levels of 504 perks, sorted by perk id then level. Requirements are Category(values) in the order the definition adds them. Stat bonuses are Stat=value for no creature ("engine" if the bonus needs the engine), so a bonus that depends on equipment reads as its unequipped value. descriptionFingerprint is the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 description text.
